thread:
katie-sales: Heads-up: Nebula Labs POC blocked during Dedicated pool creation in asia-northeast1. Pool shows pending and deployer logs an authentication+quota error. Customer wants APAC only. Can PS/Platform triage? :warning:

leo-ps: Pool request id nebula-pool-21. Deployer returned 403 + provider quota message. Paste below.
```
HTTP/1.1 403 Forbidden
\{"code":"QUOTA_LIMIT_REACHED","message":"GPUs unavailable in asia-northeast1 for project nebula-labs-prod"\}
```

nina-eng: Is this a strict single-AZ + a100-80gb request? That SKU is scarce in jp regions. If their security form mandates single-AZ local residency, fallback is constrained.

arjun-ops: Confirming request: a100-80gb x3, az_affinity=true. Our orchestrator currently refuses to downgrade automatically when az_affinity==true to avoid violating contract.

katie-sales: Customer originally wrote single-AZ due to internal audit. They might accept same-region multi-AZ if we document controls. I'll check. For unblocking, any short-term options?

claire-oncall: Quick check: we have an infra reserve in asia-northeast1 but it's tagged for enterprise trials. Rebind would require product-ops approval and a quick infra change. I can execute rebind once approved.

infra-bot: EVENT: provisioning_attempt queued (nebula-pool-21) at 2026-03-21T03:04:11Z. Provider quotas: a100-80gb: 0, a40: 5, t4: 12. Auto-retry disabled due to az_affinity flag.

leo-ps: Suggestion for immediate unblock: (1) Offer quantized model on a40 in-region (perf delta ~small), (2) Offer 1x a100 bound from reserve + rest on a40 (mixed pool) — but mixed pool might not satisfy their single-AZ strictness, (3) Ask for temporary exception to route a single replica to us-central1 for demo only. Which do we want to propose to Nebula?

nina-eng: I can produce a 1-page perf note: a40 quantized vs a100 baseline latency and token throughput. Also include basic risk note for multi-AZ.

katie-sales: Please do. Also we need a quick pricing snippet for a 14-day POC reserved commit that includes SKU substitution clause. Do we have a one-liner?

arjun-ops: Quick ops ETA: If product-ops approves reassign, I can rebind 1-3 a100 from infra-reserve-apac in ~15 minutes; otherwise quota raise ticket takes 2-12 hours normally.

leo-ps: Copying the payload we sent to cloud for repro. Use this when we open support ticket: 
```
{
  "project": "nebula-labs-prod",
  "region": "asia-northeast1",
  "sku": "a100-80gb",
  "az_affinity": true,
  "replicas": 3
}
```

nina-eng: Also include these orchestrator logs: 
```
2026-03-21T03:04:11Z orchestrator: create:nebula-pool-21
2026-03-21T03:04:34Z cloudapi: auth:ok
2026-03-21T03:04:46Z cloudapi:error QUOTA_LIMIT_REACHED a100-80gb
2026-03-21T03:04:46Z orchestrator: create:halt nebula-pool-21 reason=quota
```

katie-sales: I've asked Nebula SRE if they will accept a40 quantized for the demo while we pursue quota request. Their compliance mgr is looping in legal.

arjun-ops: I've opened product-ops thread for approval to rebind 2x a100 -> nebula-pool-21. Ticket: PO-3229. Tagging @product-ops now.

infra-bot: ACTION: quota_increase_request created (ticket GCP-55212) for a100-80gb in asia-northeast1. Expected window: 1-8 hours.

leo-ps: If quota increase is rejected, plan B: propose quantized a40 with a short performance appendix and a temporary addendum in the security questionnaire stating GPU class differs for demo. Legal signoff required.

nina-eng: Drafted perf blurb, pasting summary: 
"Quantized model on a40 (fp16+8-bit) shows ~3% increase in response time, ~2.5% drop in R-precision on our test prompts. Memory usage reduces by ~40%, enabling 3 replicas on single a40 node for similar concurrency. Suitable for functional demo but not exact perf parity."

katie-sales: Good. I'll send that to Nebula now and request permission for quantized demo while we seek quota. Also including the 14-day reserved POC pricing note: 
```
- 14-day reserved POC
- Pro-rated billing based on committed vGPU count
- One allowed SKU substitution during the POC with documented performance note
- If migration required mid-POC, we offer a one-time plan migration credit
```

arjun-ops: product-ops replied: temporary rebind allowed for high-priority POC. Approving reassign of 2x a100 from infra-reserve-apac to nebula-pool-21. Proceeding to bind.

infra-bot: NOTE: manual_rebind started for nebula-pool-21 -> infra-reserve-apac at 2026-03-21T03:19:40Z

claire-oncall: Binding complete. Nebula pool now bound to reserved hardware. Please notify customer.

katie-sales: Nebula confirmed they accept the temporary binding for the demo. Closing immediate blocker. We'll follow up with a post-POC runbook to avoid this in future. Thanks everyone :party_parrot:

leo-ps: Filing postmortem checklist: add more granular quota telemetry per region, add warn when az_affinity==true and SKU scarce, and update sales POC template to include substitution clause.

nina-eng: I'll add the perf note and the test script we ran to /contrib/poc-evals for reference.

katie-sales: Great. I'll update the customer-facing email and mark this POC as unblocked.
